## harness-python/v0.3.2

_Auto-drafted from commits in `harness-python/v0.3.1..harness-python/v0.3.2`, grouped by conventional-commit type. Edit on the release page after publish if you want a polished writeup; the canonical release notes live on the website._

### 🚀 Features

- feat(tools)!: consolidate shared agent tool streaming logic (#5079) (519fb6638)
- feat(decisions): add decision usage to the request's invocation context (#5304) (5adc6a6d3)
- feat(python): add experimental OpenAI Live provider (#5286) (420cedca4)
- feat(skills): add docs-verifier skill (#5268) (0a99337e2)
- feat(agent): enforce invoke limits and usage accounting across the whole agent tree (#4667) (6992d10e6)

- feat(changelog): add harness, CLI, and box release streams (#5192) (e67dda528)
- feat(stop): use agent.cancel() to stop the event loop (Python) (#4833) (cf0c6aeee)
- feat(vended-tools): add swarm tool in Python (#4922) (b85c373ef)
- feat(middleware): make the Python middleware system public (#4976) (16324308e)
- feat(telemetry): port baggage propagation to TypeScript (#5073) (fbc697768)
- feat(catalog): add attenu-guard (community intervention) (#3998) (a2c4fb492)

### 🐛 Fixes

- fix(models): add Gemini 3.8 Flash context window and integ smoke tests (py + ts) (#5392) (0abec0bca)

- fix(models): add context window limits for GPT-6 Sol, Luna and 6.1 Sol (py + ts) (#5147) (02a83fc7d)

- docs(evals): add StructuredOutputSimilarity evaluator page (#4464) (6d3419535)
- docs(evals): fix and refine getting-started examples and description and drop redundant Overview headings (#5195) (287ec07e0)
- docs: revise custom-tools page (#5088) (1f4b6aba8)
- docs(catalog): add LangWatch observability integration (#5167) (d7382057f)

- test(litellm): skip flaky multi-turn cache read test (#5314) (7a0f7bab2)

- ci(docs): bump sanitize-html from 2.17.7 to 2.18.1 in /site in the npm_and_yarn group across 1 directory (#5348) (3aca339b0)
- ci(typescript): bump qs from 6.15.2 to 6.16.1 (#4123) (7e7070486)

- ci(typescript): bump the production-minor group across 1 directory with 2 updates (#5133) (d67cad2d3)
- ci(docs): bump node-html-parser from 9.0.4 to 9.0.5 in /site (#5345) (b18627aaa)
- ci(python): bump cedarpy from 4.12.0 to 4.12.2 in /strands-py (#5227) (995ad7ae6)
- ci(docs): bump markdown-it from 15.0.2 to 15.0.3 in /site (#5225) (a9e1f1284)
- ci: bump actions/download-artifact from 8.0.1 to 8.0.2 (#5097) (1386ddcbf)

- ci(docs): bump @astrojs/starlight from 0.41.9 to 0.42.6 in /site (#4875) (8bdd7da92)
- ci(catalog): apply area-catalog label to PRs touching catalog entries (#5334) (ee033b96e)
- ci(typescript): bump hono from 4.13.8 to 4.13.13 (#5302) (df6fef273)
- ci: bump re-actors/alls-green from 1.2.2 to 1.3.0 (#3963) (ee5e568e4)
- ci(docs): bump @astrojs/markdown-remark from 7.3.1 to 7.3.3 in /site (#5229) (1adcaf9fb)

### 🔖 Other

- catalog: add opencode model provider (#4887) (67e45dd11)
- Add strands-you (You.com web tools plugin) to the integrations catalog (#5057) (fbf4085e9)
